options.name: color
options.description: Only fetch jobs with the given status color.

options.name: glob
options.description: A shell glob of Jenkins job names to fetch information about.

options.name: name
options.description: Exact name of the Jenkins job to fetch information about.

options.name: password
options.description: Password to authenticate with the Jenkins server. This is mutually exclusive with O(token).

options.name: token
options.description: API token used to authenticate with the Jenkins server. This is mutually exclusive with O(password).

options.name: url
options.description: URL where the Jenkins server is accessible.

options.name: user
options.description: User to authenticate with the Jenkins server.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If set to V(false), the SSL certificates are not validated. This should only set to V(false) used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.
